"""Regenerate retained synthetic inputs and read the immutable queue selection."""

from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from platform_core.json_utils import JSONObject, JSONValue, dump_json_str, require_str
from platform_core.load_report import post_load_report
from covenant_ml.markets import _test_hooks
from covenant_ml.markets.encrypted_records import decode_encrypted_bundle
from covenant_ml.markets.validation import read_document
from fleet.contracts.research import decode_research_request
from fleet.core.research_control import read_specification, verified_input
from tests.markets._crsp_study_fixtures import pre_entry_rows, study_protocol
from tests.markets._crsp_fixtures import write_sources

root = Path(__file__).parent
source = root / "source"
generated = root / "regenerated"
generated.mkdir(mode=0o700)
rows = pre_entry_rows()
manifest_path, manifest = write_sources(generated, rows, study_protocol())
fixture_files: JSONObject = {
    str(path.relative_to(source)): sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    for path in source.rglob("*") if path.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in path.parts
}
bundle_path = root.parent / "validation" / "bundle.json"
bundle_digest = sha256(bundle_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert bundle_digest == "f793bf9c611c3a8c0c5c38e0b51f78709a77c58f36fa7dc96b65c6620fb51b1f"
bundle = decode_encrypted_bundle(read_document(bundle_path))
plain_files: list[JSONValue] = []
for file in bundle["files"]:
    expected = file["plaintext"]
    actual = generated / expected["name"]
    digest = sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert digest == expected["sha256"], "REHEARSAL_REGEN_DIGEST"
    assert actual.stat().st_size == expected["size_bytes"], "REHEARSAL_REGEN_SIZE"
    plain_files.append({"name": actual.name, "sha256": digest, "size_bytes": actual.stat().st_size})
assert sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == bundle["manifest"]["sha256"]
reference: JSONObject = {"backend": "hpc3",
    "specSha256": "0ac9237726fb993986c43a61d415c2d2333eac5fc359e1e611324b5a0d1b4402",
    "attempt": "protocol-v2-be59eebf-1"}
spec = read_specification(Path("/home/corvis/research-data/wrds/queue"),
    decode_research_request(reference), "2e137b5f-f77f-4b42-9c33-ce818d0451ea")
inputs: JSONObject = {}
for key in ("script", "policy", "trial", "cluster"):
    path = verified_input(spec, key)
    inputs[key] = {"path": str(path), "sha256": sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
selected = require_str(spec, "python")
cluster = read_document(verified_input(spec, "cluster"))
assert selected == require_str(cluster, "python"), "REHEARSAL_CONTROLLER_SELECTION"
report: JSONObject = {
    "kind": "REHEARSAL_FIXTURE_AND_QUEUE_EVIDENCE",
    "observed_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "reporter_sha256": sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "source_commit": "8ef7e0f1769e7127feabb30008d72bc70e908111",
    "source_archive_sha256": sha256(Path("/home/corvis/research-data/wrds/runtime/protocol-v2-8ef7e0f17/source.tgz").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "fixture_function": "tests.markets._crsp_study_fixtures.pre_entry_rows",
    "source_files": fixture_files,
    "plaintext_files": plain_files,
    "manifest_sha256": sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "delisting_rows": list(rows["delists"]),
    "row_counts": {name: len(records) for name, records in rows.items()},
    "bundle_sha256": bundle_digest,
    "queue_reference": reference,
    "selected_evaluator_python": selected,
    "verified_queue_inputs": inputs,
    "native_attempt": require_str(spec, "native_attempt"),
    "scope": "Synthetic regeneration and immutable specification readback; no licensed inputs, keys, new jobs or journal mutations. Selection names the evaluator; it is not a new historical process attestation."
}
payload = dump_json_str(report)
(root / "report.json").write_text(payload)
post_load_report(post=_test_hooks.http_post, read_text=_test_hooks.stack_text,
    task_id="be59eebf-5cfe-4116-986c-c84962f7cb18", family="hpc",
    body="REHEARSAL FIXTURE AND QUEUE LOAD-REPORT\n" + payload)
